title: Manuel Perez as a sweet player and Chicago's welcome for New Orleans music
summary: Perez was a sweet, not hot, trumpeter and Tea did the hot playing; Chicago audiences loved New Orleans music.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Chicago was full of gangsters in those days. Was Perez a hot player or was he more of a sweet player?
He wasn't no hot player. He was a sweet player.
A sweet player. And so did --
He played a lot of trumpet but he wasn't no hot man, no.
Okay. Did -- so did Teal play some of the jazz, make it go?
